title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. NTIRUSHWAMABOKO
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. NTIRUSHWAMABOKO
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA00208/2025/CA (Kanyange, J. P.) 29 Ukuboza 2025]
Amategeko agenga ibimenyetso – Imanza nshinjabyaha – Ibimenyetso mu manza nshinjabyaha – Mu
manza nshinjabyaha, ibimenyetso byose bishobora gushingirwaho mu gihe bigaragaza ukuri kw’ibyabaye
(principe de la liberté de la preuve en matière pénale) ababuranyi bakaba barahawe uburyo bwo kuhaba
ngo banyomozanye.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Ubushinjacyaha bwareze Ntirushwamaboko mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo,
bumukurikiranyeho icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana w’umukobwa w’imyaka 15 bumusabira igifungo
cy’imyaka makumyabiri n’itanu (25). Uyu yaburanye ahakana icyaha ashinjwa avuga ko atari kwifasha
umukobwa w’imyaka 15 ngo amukuremo ikariso amusambanye, ko ahubwo yamufashe amaze kwiba
ibishyimbo. Urukiko rwaciye urubanza, rushingiye ku bimenyetso bitandukanye birimo imvugo
y’umwana wasambanyijwe, imvugo z’abatangabuhamya na raporo ya muganga, rumuhamya icyo cyaha
ndetse rumuhanisha igifungo cy’imyaka 15.
Uregwa yajuririye mu Rukiko Rukuru avuga ko yahamijwe icyaha atakoze, ahubwo ko yahimbiwe ubwo
yafataga uwo mwana w’umukobwa yibye ibishyimbo, amureze babona kumuhimbira, ko kandi nta
wemeje ko yamubonye amusambanya, ndetse n’ibimenyetso byashingiweho bikaba bishidikanywaho.
Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko izo mpamvu z’ubujurire Uregwa yatanze nta shingiro zifite, kuko hari
ibimenyetso byashingiweho bigaragaza ko uwo mwana yasambanyijwe, akaba kandi yarahakanye ko
yibye ibishyimbo.
Urukiko Rukuru rwaciye urubanza, rusanga ubujurire bw’Uregwa nta shingiro bufite kuko atabashije
kuvuguruza ibimenyetso byashingiweho bimuhamya icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana, ngo agaragaze ko
atariwe wamusambanyije, rusanga kandi rusesenguye neza Uregwa ariwe waranduye ibyo bishyimbo
avuga ko byibwe, mu rwego rwo gusibanganya ibimenyetso by’icyaha yari amaze gukora. Urukiko
Rukuru rwemeje ko hagumaho imikirize y’urubanza rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rwisumbuye.
Uregwa yongeye kujuririra muri uru Rukiko rw’Ubujurire avuga ko yahamijwe icyaha hashingiwe ku
bimenyetso bishidikanywaho bigizwe na raporo ya muganga, imvugo z’umwana, iza se, n’ubuhamya bwa
Munyemana na Mukashyaka, ko kandi hatabajijwe abatangabuhamya be.
Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije ubujurire bw’Uregwa buvuga ko izo mpamvu z’ubujurire nta shingiro zifite,
kuko nta gushidikanya kuri mu bimenyetso byashingiweho, ko n’abatangabuhamya avuga ko batabajijwe
nta wemeje ko yamusanze ari kumwe n’umwana aregwa ko yasambanyije.
Incamake y’icyemezo: Mu manza nshinjabyaha, ibimenyetso byose bishobora gushingirwaho mu gihe
bigaragaza ukuri kw’ibyabaye (principe de la liberté de la preuve en matière pénale) ababuranyi bakaba
barahawe uburyo bwo kuhaba ngo banyomozanye.
Ubujurire nta shingiro bufite.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko Nº 062/2024 ryo ku wa 20/06/2024 rigenga ibimenyetso, ingingo ya 87.
Itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange nk’uko ryahinduwe,
ingingo ya 133.
Itegeko N° 15/2004 ryo ku wa 12/06/2004 ryerekeye ibimenyetso mu manza n’itangwa ryabyo, ingingo
ya 119.

Imanza zifashishijwe:
RPAA00866/2024/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Kambari Paul, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa
29/09/2025.
RPAA00692/2021/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Ndayishimiye Jean Damascène, rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 20/01/2023.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] Umwana w’umukobwa w’imyaka 15 wiswe U.D mu rubanza rujuririrwa, yagiye kwa
MUKASHYAKA Pauline ku wa 21/12/2020 kumufasha gusarura imiteja, akavuga ko yarangije akamuha
ibishyimbo ngo ajyane iwabo agahura na NTIRUSHWAMABOKO yikoreye ibyo bishyimbo, nyuma
abwira se ko uwo musore yamusabye kumuha ku bintu nawe akamuha 1000 Frw, amukururira mu masaka
aramusambanya, se atanga ikirego mu Bugenzacyaha bituma Ntirushwamaboko atangira gukurikiranwa.
[2] Nyuma y’iperereza, Ubushinjacyaha bwamureze mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo
bumukurikiranyeho icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana, bushingiye ku mvugo z’uwo mwana, imvugo
z’abatangabuhamya na raporo ya muganga, bumusabira igifungo cy’imyaka makumyabiri n’itanu (25).
[3] Ntirushwamaboko Jean Berchmans yaburanye ahakana icyaha, avuga ko atari kwifasha
umukobwa w’imyaka 15 ngo amukuremo ikariso amusambanye, ko ahubwo yamufashe amaze kwiba
ibishyimbo.
[4] Urukiko rwaciye urubanza RP00148/2021/TGI/GSBO ku wa 09/12/2021, rusanga n’ubwo
Ntirushwamaboko ahakana icyaha akurikiranweho, atabasha kuvuguruza ibimenyetso byatanzwe
n’Ubushinjacyaha birimo imvugo z’abatangabuhamya n’iz’umwana wasambanyijwe, raporo ya muganga
na raporo y’inzego z’ibanze, rusanga ariko yagabanyirizwa igihano yasabiwe n’Ubushinjacyaha,
rumuhanisha igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15).
[5] Ntirushwamaboko Jean Berchmans yajuriye mu Rukiko Rukuru avuga ko yahamijwe icyaha
atakoze, ko atasambanyije U.D ahubwo yamufashe arimo kwiba ibishyimbo, amureze babona
kumuhimbira ko yamusambanyije, ko nta wemeje ko yamubonye amusambanya ahubwo ko hashingiwe
ku bimenyetso bivuguruzanya.
[6] Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije ko ibyo Ntirushwamaboko ashingiraho ubujurire bwe nta shingiro
bifite, kuko uwo avuga ko U.D. yibwe ibishyimbo yabihakanye, ko kandii hari ibimenyetso
byashingiweho bigaragaza ko uwo mwana yasambanyijwe.
[7] Urukiko rwaciye urubanza RPA01854/2021/HC/KIG ku wa 29/01/2025, rusanga impamvu
z’ubujurire bwe nta shingiro zifite, kuko atabashije kuvuguruza ibimenyetso byashingiweho bigizwe
n’imvugo za U.D wasobanuye uko bahuye akamusambanya, imvugo za se, ubuhamya bwa
Mukashyaka Pauline hamwe na raporo ya muganga. Rwasobanuye kandi ko iby’uko uwo mwana
yafashwe arandura ibishyimbo bitahabwa agaciro, ko ahubwo mu busesenguzi bwarwo rusanga
byararanduwe na Ntirushwamaboko amaze kumusambanya kugira ngo ahishe icyaha yakoze, ko
kandi kuba umwana yaravuze ko yitwa Uwase Divine mu gihe icyemezo cy’amavuko kigaragaza ko
yitwa Uwase Sandrine, bitatesha agaciro icyo cyemezo kuko se yavuze ko habayeho kwibeshya kandi
hakaba hariho ifoto y’uwo mwana, Ntirushwamaboko nawe akaba atagaragaza ko atari we yarezwe
gusambanya. Rwemeje rero ko hagumaho imikirize y’urubanza rwajuririwe.

[8] Ntirushwamaboko Jean Berchmans yongeye ajurira mu Rukiko rw’Ubujurire, urubanza
rwandikwa kuri RPAA00208/2025/CA, iburanisha ribera mu ruhame ku wa 07/10/2025 no ku wa
24/10/2025 yunganiwe na Me Micomyiza Lilian na Me Gashyayija Mathieu, Ubushinjacyaha
buhagarariwe na Sibomana Stanislas, Umushinjacyaha ku rwego rw’Igihugu. Urubanza rwongeye
kuburanishwa ku wa 04/12/2029 kugira ngo Urukiko rwumve abatangabuhamya hamwe n’umwana
Ntirushwamaboko ashinjwa gusambanya, ariko uwo munsi uwo mwana ntiyitaba ahubwo humvwa
umubyeyi we n’abatangabuhamya bitabye Urukiko.
[9] Mu myanzuro y’ubujurire no mu miburanire, Ntirushwamaboko Jean Berchmans n’umwunganira
bavuga ko yahamijwe icyaha hashingiwe ku bimenyetso bishidikanywaho bigizwe na raporo ya muganga,
imvugo za U.D., iza se, n’ubuhamya bwa Munyemana Athanase na Mukashyaka Pauline, ko kandi
hatabajijwe abatangabuhamya be.
[10] Uhagararariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko izo mpamvu z’ubujurire nta shingiro zifite, kuko nta
gushidikanya kuri mu bimenyetso byashingiweho, ko n’abatangabuhamya avuga ko batabajijwe nta
wemeje ko yamusanze ari kumwe na U.D.
[11] Ikibazo kigomba gusuzumwa muri uru rubanza ni ukumenya niba Urukiko rwarahamije
Ntirushwamaboko icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana rushingiye ku bimenyetso bishidikanywaho
ntirunabaze abatangabuhamye be.
II. ISESENGURA RY’IKIBAZO KIRI MU RUBANZA
Kumenya niba Urukiko rwarahamije Ntirushwamaboko icyaha cyo gusambanya rushingiye ku
bimenyetso bishidikanywaho ntirunabaze abatangabuhamya be
[12] Ntirushwamaboko n’umwunganira bavuga ko yahamijwe icyaha hashingiwe ku bimenyetso
bishidikanywaho, birimo raporo ya muganga kuko itemeza nta shiti ko U.D yasambanyijwe ku wa
21/12/2020, ko n’ubwo muganga yavuze ko habayeho imibonano mpuzabitsina atavuze igihe
yakorewe,hakaba rero hatakwemezwa ko ari ku wa 21/12/2020, kuko uwo munsi, yaba uwo mwana, yaba
umubyeyi we cyangwa abandi bantú bageze ahari habereye ikibazo cy’ubujura bw’ibishyimbo, ntawavuze
ko habayeho gusambanya uwo mwana, ahubwo bigaragara ko hashize iminsi 2 ababyeyi be bamwigisha
ko akwiye kuvuga ko yasambanyijwe na Ntirushwamaboko aho gukomeza kumutera urubwa avuga ko
yibye ibishyimbo; ko rero iyo raporo ituzuye kuko itabasha gukemura impaka, kandi ko n’ubwo Urukiko
rwasanga yarasambanyijwe mu gihe cya vuba byaba byarakozwe n’undi utari Ntirushwamaboko.
[13] Bavuga kandi ko Urukiko rwashingiye ku mvugo za U.D kandi zigaragaza ko atazi amazina
y’uwamusambanyije ndetse akaba atazi amazina ye kuko yiyise U.S ubundi U.D, bikaba bigaragaza ko
ibyo ashinja Ntirushwamaboko ari ibinyoma yahimbye afatanyije n’ababyeyi be mu rwego rwo kwikuraho
igisebo, bitewe n’uko yamufashe arandura ibishyimbo ashaka kongera ibyo yari akuye kwa Mukashyaka,
n’abatangabuhamya be batabajijwe bakaba baramusanganye ibyo bishyimbo, n’aho yabiranduye
hagaragara.
[14] Banavuga ko Urukiko rwashingiye ku mvugo za se wa U.D kandi zitarimo ukuri, bitewe n’uko
abazwa mu Bugenzacyaha yavuze ko amakuru y’isambanywa ry’umwana we ari we wayamubwiye, ko
nta wundi muntu wabimenye, anavuga ko yasambanyijwe na Ntirushwamaboko mu gihe uwo mwana
yavuze ko atazi amazina y’uwamusambanyije, ko rero ubwo buhamya butahabwa agaciro kuko
buvuguguruzanya n’ubw’uwamuhaye amakuru.
[15] Ntirushwamaboko n’umwunganira bavuga kandi ko hashingiwe ku buhamya bukemangwa bwa
Munyemana Athanase na Mukashyaka Pauline bavuze ibyo batojwe n’abafite inyungu zo kumufungisha,
ndetse imvugo za Mukashyaka zikaba zivuguruzanya n’iza Nsanzimana Evariste, kuko Mukashyaka

yavuze ko ari we wahaye U.D ibishyimbo, mu gihe Nsanzimana yabonye ko yabyibye kuko yageze aho
byabereye agasaba imbabazi.
[16] Ntirushwamaboko n’umwunganira banavuga ko Urukiko rwabogamiye ku ruhande rumwe bituma
rwemeza ko yasambanyije umwana, kandi aho yamusanze yiba ibishyimbo mu murima wa Hitayezu
Valens hari abandi bantu bahageze ako kanya, barimo Rusanganwa Callixte, Nizeyimana Gaspard na
Mutuyimana Ester, ariko bakaba batarabajijwe kandi bazi ukuri, hakaba hari n’abaturage babajijwe
bikorerwa raporo, bemeje ko hari ibishyimbo byibwe, ko rero iyo U.D. aza kuba yarasambanyijwe aba
yarabibwiye abatangabuhamya bahageze ariko batabajijwe, ko ndetse n’uwitwa Mutuyimana Esther yaje
kureba ibyo bishyimbo ari kumwe n’uwo mwana ariko ntiyamubwira ko yasambanyijwe.
[17] Ku byo abatangabuhamya hamwe na se wa U.D. basobanuriye uru Rukiko, Ntirushwamaboko
n’umwunganira bavuga ko imvugo zabo zumvikanisha ko nta muntu U.D yabwiye ko yasambanyijwe
cyangwa ngo habe hari uwumvise ko yasambanyijwe, ko kandi ibyo se yavugiye mu Rukiko
bivuguruzanya n’ibyo yavuze mbere, kuko mu Rukiko yavuze ko yahuye na Ntirushwamaboko agenda
mu gihe mbere yari yavuze ko yamanukanye na Munyemana bagiye kureba Ntirushwamaboko, ko rero
ubuhamya bwatanzwe bushimangira imiburanire yabo y’uko nta cyaha yakoze.
[18] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko impamvu z’ubujurire bwa Ntirushwamaboko nta shingiro
zifite, kuko ku birebana na raporo ya muganga, dosiye igaragaza ko icyaha cyakozwe ku wa 21/12/2020,
se w’umwana ahita ajya mu kazi k’izamu atanga ikirego bukeye ku wa 22/12, bamuha urwandiko
rumujyana kwa muganga ajyayo ku wa 23/12, hakorwa raporo yagaragaje ko umwana yari afite
ibimenyetso byo gusambanywa mu gihe cya vuba, kandi Ntirushwamaboko akaba atagaragaza niba hari
undi muntu wavuzwe utari we cyangwa undi waba waraketswe.
[19] Avuga kandi ko nta kosa Urukiko rwakoze rushingira ku mvugo za U.D, wasobanuye ko
yasambanyijwe na Ntirushwamaboko yabona agiye kumurega agahimba ko amufashe yiba ibishyimbo
kandi ibyo yari yikoreye yaragaragaje aho byari bivuye, iby’uko yasambanyijwe kandi bikaba
bishimangirwa na raporo ya muganga wamusuzumye nyuma y’iminsi 2 ikagaragaza ko yari afite
ibimenyetso by’uko yasambanyijwe, kandi umwana w’imyaka 15 akaba atayoberwa kuvuga
ibyamubayeho, ko no kuba atamenya izina ry’uwamusambanyije bitavanaho ko byakozwe na
Ntirushwamaboko.
[20] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga kandi ko nta kuvuguruzanya kuri mu mvugo za U.D n’iza se,
kuko uyu yavuze ibyo yabwiwe n’umwana we ko yasambanyijwe, amusobanurira aho byabereye maze
ahita yumva ko ari Ntirushwamaboko wabikoze, ko kandi ibyo gusaba imbabazi yabikoze atarabonana
n’uwo mwana ngo amubwire ibyamubayeho.
[21] Ku birebana n’abatangabuhamya Ntirushwamaboko avuga ko bakemangwa, uhagarariye
Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko uwitwa Munyemana yavuze ko bahuye akamubwira ko umwana wo kwa
Kazungu (Nsanzimana) yibye ibishyimbo ariko akaba atarabonye uwo mwana aho ngaho kuko yari
yagiye, Mukashyaka Pauline nawe yemeza ko yari yahaye uwo mwana ibishyimbo ngo ajyane iwabo, ko
rero ntaho bigeze bavuga ko babonye Ntirushwamaboko amusambanya cyangwa ngo bahamye ko
babonye U.D arandura ibishyimbo cyangwa se ngo Urukiko rube rwaravuze ko bamushinja gusambanya
uwo mwana, ahubwo ko bavuze ko abeshyerwa ko yibye ibishyimbo.
[22] Naho ku batangabuhamya Ntirushwamaboko avuga ko batabajijwe, uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha
avuga ko ntacyo bakungura Urukiko kuko batasanze umwana aho yasambanyirijwe, ko abahageze
babonye koko ibishyimbo biri ukubiri ariko ko ntawabonye Ntirushwamaboko afatira U.D mu murima,
ko kandi atari kwiba ibishyimbo afite ibindi yari yahawe, ko ahubwo yabonye uwo mwana agiye (amaze
kumusambanya) arandura ibishyimbo abishyira ku byo yari afite, ko umwana agarutse aho aribwo
abatangabuhamya bamubonye, ko kandi n’abahageze bazanwe na Ntirushwamaboko abakuye ku

muhanda nk’uko yabivuze mu Bugenzacyaha, naho kuba umwana ataravuze ko yasambanyijwe bikaba
byaratewe n’isoni n’igisebo no kuba hari mu ruhame kandi nta na mwene wabo bari kumwe.
[23] Ku byo abatangabuhamya basobanuye uru Rukiko, uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko
ubuhamya bwabo bwumvikanisha ko nta n’umwe wahagaze kubyo avuga, ko no kuvuga ko U.D atabwiye
Mutuyimana ko yasambanyijwe bitahabwa agaciro kuko atigeze (U.D) asubira ahakorewe icyaha, kuko
na Ntirushwamaboko yavuze ko yahise akubita ihene aragenda, bivuze ko ntaho bongeye guhurira, kandi
ko uwo mwana atahuye na se ngo amubwire ibyamubayeho ahubwo yabibwiye mama Gihozo, ko rero
ibyo abatangabuhamya bavuze nta kuri kurimo.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[24] Impaka muri uru rubanza zishingiye ku kumenyana niba ibimenyetso byashingiweho
Ntirushwamaboko ahamwa n’icyaha bishidikanywaho, no kumenya niba byari ngombwa kuva
abatangabuhamya be.
[25] Ikibazo kirebenana n’ibimenyetso mu manza, cyasesenguwe mu rubanza
RPAA00692/2021/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 20/01/2023 haburana Ubushinjacyaha
na Ndayishimiye Jean Damascène. Muri urwo rubanza hasesenguwe ingingo ya 119 y’Itegeko N°
15/2004 ryo ku wa 12/06/2004 ryerekeye ibimenyetso mu manza n’itangwa ryabyo1, harebwe cyane
cyane ku mwihariko w’imanza nshinjabyaha, maze Urukiko rusobanura ko mu manza nshinjabyaha,
ibimenyetso byose bishobora gushingirwaho mu gihe bigaragaza ukuri kw’ibyabaye (principe de la
liberté de la preuve en matière pénale) ababuranyi bakaba barahawe uburyo bwo kuhaba ngo
banyomozanye. Ibi byanashingiweho mu zindi manza zaciwe zakurikiyeho, harimo urubanza
RPAA00866/2024/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 29/09/2025, haburana Ubushinjacyaha
na Kambari Paul.
[26] Kugira ngo Urukiko Rukuru rwemeze ko Ntirushwamaboko ahamwa n’icyaha cyo gusambanya
umwana nk’uko cyamuhamye ku rwego rwa mbere, rwabishingiye ku bimenyetso bigizwe n’imvugo za
U.D., imvugo za se, ubuhamya bwa Mukashyaka Pauline hamwe na raporo ya muganga.
[27] Mu birebana n’imvugo za U.D., mu nyandikomvugo yakoreye mu Bugenzacyaha, yasobanuye ko
ku wa 21/12/2020 yavuye kwa Mukashyaka Pauline yikoreye ibishyimbo, ahura n’umuntu aramuhagarika
amubwira ko amushaka, amubaza icyo amushakira undi amubwira ngo ature ibishyimbo ahagarare, ahita
abikurura abimukura ku mutwe, abimwatse ngo yigendere ahita amubwira ko icyo yamushakiraga ari uko
yamuha ku bintu nawe akamuha 1000Frw, ahita amufata amukururira mu masaka aramutega agwa hasi
aramusambanya, avuza induru ariko ntihagira ubyumva, birangiye ahita ataha agiye kubibwira se ariko
asanga adahari, abibwira mama Gihozo na Uwizeye.
[28] Mu nyandikomvugo ya Nsanzimana Evariste ari we Se wa U.D., yasobanuye ko ubwo yari agiye
kureba aho abana bari baragiye amatungo, yahuye n’abantu bamubwira ko Ntirushwamaboko arimo
kumushaka, amanutse asanga ari kumwe na Munyemana, Ntirushwamaboko ahita amubwira ko yasanze
umwana we arandura ibishyimbo, agiye kureba asanga hari ibishyimbo bidahuye n’ibyo uwo mwana yari
yakuye kwa Mukashyaka, ahita amubwira ko bazabisubiramo kuko yari agiye ku kazi, nyuma ahura n’uwo
mwana agiye mu rugo, amubwira ko yahuye n’umugabo wari uragiye amubwira ngo ature ibishyimbo
yari yikoreye, yanze ahita abishika aramubwira ngo arashaka ko amuha ku bintu nawe akamuga 1000Frw,
ahita amukurubana amujyana mu masaka ahita amutera ivi mu nda amukuramo ikariso, arangije
aramubwira ngo namuve imbere ngo n’abandi arabaha ntibagire icyo bamuha.
1 Iyo ngingo ihura n’ingingo ya 87 y’Itegeko Nº 062/2024 ryo ku wa 20/06/2024 rigenga ibimenyetso.

[29] Naho mu buhamya bwa Mukashyaka Pauline, yasobanuye ko U.D. na mukase baje kumusarurira
imiteje, mukase aza gutaha naho umwana asigara amufasha, nyuma amwereka aho arandura ibishyimbo
by’umutonore arangije arikorera arataha, nyuma aza kumva ko hari umugabo wamufashe ngo arimo
arandura ibishyimbo, ariko bukeye amenya ko uwo mwana yahuye na Berchmans akamubwira ngo amuhe
ku bintu nawe aramuha 1000Frw, yanze aramukurubana amujyana mu masaka aramusambanya.
[30] Ku birebana na raporo ya muganga, igaragaza ko U.D. yasuzumwe ku wa 23/12/2020, mu
mwanzuro ikaba ivuga ko hari ibimenyetso by’uko yasambanyijwe mu gihe cya vuba bihujwe
n’ubuhamya bwatanzwe (the above clinical finding are suggestive of recent sexual assault (abuse)
correlative with their testimonies).
[31] Ku bivugwa na Ntirushwamaboko n’umwunganira ko raporo ya muganga itavuze ko U.D.
yasambanyijwe ku wa 21/12/2020, Urukiko rurasanga kugira ngo iyo raporo ikorwe, byarashingiye ku
makuru yatanzwe na U.D ko yahuye na Ntirushwamaboko ku wa 21/12/2020 akamusambanya,
bikagaragara ko ku wa 22/12/2020, Ubugenzacyaha byasabye muganga gusuzuma uwo mwana
akagaragaza niba hari ibimenyetso by’uko yasambanyijwe, iryo suzuma rikorwa ku wa 23/12/2020
hanakorwa raporo igaragaza ibyo muganga yabonye ku gitsina cy’umwana, avuga ko ibimenyetso
yabonye biganisha ku kuba harabayeho isambanywa rya vuba.
[32] Urukiko rurasanga rero harebwe uko ibintu byagenze nk’uko U.D. yabisobanuye, byumvikanisha
ko ibyo raporo ya muganga yagaragaje bihura n’igikorwa cyo gusambanywa yavuze ko yakorewe na
Ntirushwamaboko ku wa 21/12/2020. Naho iby’uko uwo munsi nta muntu wavuze ko habayeho icyo
kibazo, Urukiko rurasanga abantú bavuze ko babonye U.D uwo munsi, ari Mutuyimana Esther na
Rusanganwa Callixte, Mutuyimana akaba yarasobanuye ko U.D yamusanze aho yarari akamubwira ko
hari umugabo umwambuye ibishyimbo avuga ko abyibye, ko nta kindi kibazo yamubwiye ko yagize
ahubwo bageze aho Ntirushwamaboko yari ari agatangira kumutuka. Rusanganwa Callixte nawe yavuze
ko Ntirushwamaboko yamubwiye ko yasanze U.D. arandura ibishyimbo, ko nyuma uwo mukobwa yaje
ari kumwe na Mutuyimana Esther aza atuka Ntirushwamaboko kubera ko yamwambuye ibishyimbo bye,
ariko ko nta kindi yavuze ko yaba yamukoreye.
[33] Urukiko rurasanga ariko n’ubwo abo batangabuhamya bavuze ko nta kindi U.D. yavuze usibye
ikibazo cy’ibishyimbo, bivuguruzwa n’ibyo Ntirushwammaboko yavugiye mu Bugenzacyaha, kuko
yasobanuye ko U.D. yagarukanye na Mutuyimana akamubwira ko natamuha ibishyimbo bye ajya
kumurega, ko yanavuze ko yamuhaye igihumbi kugira ngo basambane akabyanga, iyo mvugo rero ikaba
yumvikanisha ko U.D. atavuze gusa ikibazo cy’ibishyimbo yari yambuwe nk’uko Ntirushwamaboko
ashaka kubyumvikanisha kuko yanavuze ibyo kuba yarashatse kumusambanya akamuha amafaranga, ibyo
kuba yaramusambanyije akaba kandi yarageze mu rugo akabivuga, bituma nyuma yo kugeza ikibazo mu
Bugenzacyaha, busaba ko asuzumwa kugira ngo hamenyekane niba hari ibimenyetso bigaragaza ko
yasambanyijwe, raporo muganga yakoze nyuma yo kumusuzuma ikaba yaragaragaje ko hari ibimenyetso
by’uko yasambanyijwe mu gihe cya vuba, kandi harebwe uburyo ibintu byakurikiranwe, nta gushidikanya
ko ibyo raporo yagaragaje ari ingaruka z’igikorwa umwana yavuze ko yakorewe na Ntirushwamaboko ku
wa 21/12/2020.
[34] Ku birebana n’uko Urukiko rwashingiye ku mvugo za U.D. kandi yaravuze ko atazi amazina
y’uwamusambanyije ndetse akaba atanazi amazina ye, Urukiko rurasanga koko mu nyandikomvugo ya
U.D. yaravuze ko atazi izina ry’uwamuhohoteye, ibyo ariko akaba atari byo byatuma imvugo ye idahabwa
agaciro, kuko atari ihame ko umuntu amenya izina ry’uwamuhohoteye, kandi igikuru ku birebana n’uru
rubanza akaba ari uko Ntirushwamaboko adahakana ko ku wa 21/12/2020 yahuye n’umwana wa
Nsanzimana Evariste ariwe U.D, kuko yavuze ko yamusanze yiba ibishyimbo.
[35] Naho ku birebana n’uko umwana yiyise amazina atandukanye ngo kuko hamwe yavuze ko yitwa
U.D ubundi U.S, Urukiko rurasanga koko mu nyandikomvugo y’uwahohotewe, havugwamo ko ari U.D,

ariko akaba nta handi yaba yaravuze ko yitwa U.S, ahubwo bigaragara ko icyemezo cy’amavuko
cyatanzwe ari icya U.S, icyo kibazo ariko umubyeyi we akaba yaragisobanuye kuko yavuze ko habayeho
kwibeshya, ko amazina ari U.S. Byongeye kandi icyemezo cy’amavugo kiriho ifoto ye igaragara neza,
Ntirushwamaboko akaba ataragaragaje ko atari we bahuye ku wa 21/12/2020.
[36] Ku birebana n’uko ari ikinyoma cyahimbwe na U.D mu rwego rwo kwikuraho igisebo kubera ko
yari yafashwe yiba ibishyimbo, Urukiko rurasanga uko dosiye ibigaragaza, Ntirushwamaboko ari we
wenyine wavuze iby’uko yasanze U.D yiba ibishyimbo, kuko no mubo yavuze ko yahise abibwira2,
uwitwa Munyemana Athanase yavuze ko atakwemeza ko yabyibye, ubuhamya bw’abandi nabwo bukaba
bwumvikanisha ko ikibazo cy’ibishyimbo bacyumvanye Ntirushwamaboko, naho se wa U.D akaba
yarasobanuriye uru Rukiko ko twari udushyimbo tugera nko ku munani twaranduwe na Ntirushwamaboko
ashaka kubigereka kuri U.D, bivuze rero ko Urukiko rutakwemeza ko ari ikinyoma yahimbye mu rwego
rwo kwivanaho igiseho gishingiye ku iyibwa ry’ibishyimbo, cyane cyane ko adasobanura aho icyo
kinyoma cyahurira n’ibyagaragajwe na raporo ya muganga irebewe hamwe n’ibyo U.D. yavuze ko
yakorewe na Ntirushwamaboko.
[37] Ku bivugwa na Ntirushwamaboko ko Urukiko rwashingiye ku mvugo za Nsanzimana Evariste
kandi zivuguruzanya n’iza U.D, ngo kuko U.D yavuze ko atazi amazina y’uwamusambanyije mu gihe se
yavuze ko ari Ntirushwamaboko, Urukiko rurasanga nta kuvuguruzanya kuri muri izo mvugo, kuko
icy’ingenzi ari uko uwo U.D. yavuze ko yamusambanyije byaje kugaragara ko ari Ntirushwamaboko,
kandi nk’uko byavuzwe haruguru akaba adahakana ko ku wa 21/12/2020 hari igihe yari kumwe na U.D.
bonyine, uyu akavuga ko aribwo yamusambanyije.
[38] Ku birebana n’uko Urukiko rwashingiye ku buhamya bwa Mukashayaka na Munyemana Athanase
kandi bukemangwa ngo kuko bavuze ibyo batojwe n’abafite inyungu zo kumufungisha, Urukiko
rurasanga nta shingiro bifite, kuko nta kimenyetso atanga cy’uko bavuze ibyo batojwe cyangwa ngo
agaragaze abafite inyungu z’uko afungwa, dore ko mu Bugenzacyaha yabajijwe niba hari icyo asanzwe
apfa n’umuryango wa U.D cyatuma bamubehyera agasubiza ko nta kibazo bari bagirana. Naho kuba
Mukashyaka yaravuze ko ari we wahaye U.D ibishyimbo mu gihe se yabonye ko yabyibye, Urukiko
rurasanga bitafatwa ko imvugo zabo zivuguruzanya, kuko nk’uko inyandikomvugo ya se wa U.D
ibyumvikanisha, Ntirushwamaboko yabanje kujya kumwereka aho yavugaga ko yasanze uwo mwana
arandura ibishyimbo ari nabwo yasabye imbabazi nk’uko Munyemana Athanase yabisobanuye, ibyo ariko
bikaba byarabaye mbere y’uko Nsanzimana abonana na U.D, kuko inyandikomvugo ye igaragaza ko
bamaze kubonana aribwo umwana yamubwiye ibyo Ntirushwamaboko yamukoreye, kandi ko icyo gihe
yari yikoreye ibishyimbo yari avanye kwa Mukashyaka nk’uko uyu yabyemeje.
[39] Ku bivugwa na Ntirushwamaboko ko Urukiko rutabajije abantu bahageze akimara gufata U.D yiba
ibishyimbo n’abemeje ko hari ibishyimbo byibwe bigakorerwa raporo, Urukiko rurasanga uretse kuba mu
miburanire ye mu Rukiko Rukuru ntahagaragara ko ikibazo cy’abatangabuhamya batumviswe cyari mu
mpamvu z’ubujurire bwe nk’inenge iri mu rubanza yari yajuririye, n’abo uru Rukiko rwumvise,
ntawemeje ko yasanze U.D. akiri aho Ntirushwamaboko avuga ko yamufatiye yiba ibishyimbo, akaba rero
atari no kubabwira ibyamubayeho kuko batahamusanze, naho ibirebana n’ubuhamya bwa Mutuyimana
Esther Urukiko rukaba rwabivuzeho mu gika cya 33.
[40] Hashingiwe ku byasobanuwe, Urukiko rurasanga impamvu z’ubujurire bwa Ntirushamaboko Jean
Berchmans nta shingiro zifite, kuko ibimenyetso byashingiweho bigaragaza ukuri kw’ibyabaye ku
birebana n’icyaha akurikiranweho, bityo hakaba hagumyeho imikirize y’urubanza rwajuririwe n’igifungo
cy’imyaka cumi n’itani (15) yahanishijwe kuko cyagabanyijwe mu buryo buhagije harebwe ikigero
cy’imyaka yari afite n’icy’umwana yasambanyije.
